acceptedAnswer.text: Matrix Massage & Bodywork is independently owned by DaNelle Borglin, a Wisconsin licensed massage therapist. The studio is located in Salem, Wisconsin.

mainEntity.name: What brought DaNelle into massage therapy?

acceptedAnswer.text: After more than 15 years in the corporate world, including a decade running her own headhunting firm, DaNelle began pursuing a different path during the pandemic. Her experience with stress, tension, and burnout led her toward fitness, wellness, and therapeutic bodywork. That experience continues to inform her personal approach to care.

mainEntity.name: What services does the studio offer today?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matrix offers therapeutic massage and bodywork, custom facials, Japanese Head Spa, lash extensions, face and body waxing, red light therapy, and infrared sauna. Explore the service pages for details and the current booking menu for available appointments.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect at my first visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your visit begins with a conversation about your goals, preferences, and relevant health or skin considerations for the service you chose. Ask questions and let your provider know what feels comfortable. If you are unsure which service to book, text 262-939-9325 for help choosing a starting point.

mainEntity.name: Where is Matrix, and which communities does it serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matrix Massage & Bodywork is at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. The studio welcomes guests from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Pleasant Prairie, Twin Lakes, Trevor, Kenosha, Burlington, Union Grove, Genoa City, and Antioch, Illinois. All appointments are provided at this one Salem location.

mainEntity.name: How do I book an appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the online booking menu to choose a service and view current availability, or text 262-939-9325. Online scheduling is handled through Square Appointments.

mainEntity.name: Where can I follow Matrix online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Find the studio on Facebook as Matrix Massage & Bodywork – Wisconsin and on Instagram as @matrixmassagewi.
